translations.web: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
translations.bsb: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
translations.kjv: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
translations.asv: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold; for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
